sticky_notes.text: Unknown Class, P(F) > .15: Assume Class A (Okay to Quote) for: Composition/asphalt/fiberglass shingles, installed or replaced within the past 20 years; Concrete, clay, slate, and similar noncombustible roofing materials; Modern standing seam and other metal roofing systems.

Unknown Class, P(F) > .15: Combustible roofing materials, including untreated wood shake or shingle roofs, flat membrane roofs, tar & gravel, are NOT assumed Class A: require confirmation of Class A or replacement.
Acceptable evidence can include: roofing permits; contractor invoices; manufacturer documentation; inspection findings; other documentation reasonably supporting Class A roof construction.
